diagnosis: The test run trace artifact endpoint serves Playwright trace archive files containing DOM snapshots, captured session cookies, and network request headers recorded during automated runs. Because knex queries e2e_test_runs solely by runId without checking req.user.organization_id, authenticated developers can download trace archives containing credentials and private data from test runs of other organizations.
exploit_request:
GET /api/test-runs/run-9921-qa-e2e/trace-artifact HTTP/1.1
Host: ci-runner.cloudtest.dev
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...
Accept: application/zip
